title: Page 10
content_zh:
就算一开始席舞没能即时察觉到左语恩对黑少的心思，可后来当她发喜帖给她，左语恩看见新郎的名字不是黑少时，当时竟然激动得哭了，她这才恍然原来自己差点抢了左语恩喜欢的男人，破坏了人家的幸福。

“要不是我那天把你丢下来，你今天可以跟齐藤先生共结连理？恐怕是你跟我要参加齐藤先生和蓝小姐的婚礼了吧？”左语恩也不示弱，回了一句。“说到这，我看见蓝小姐也来参加婚礼了呢，说起来她也大方，千金小姐的性子少不了，却也不大讨人厌。”

“嗯。”席舞点点头。“是我对不起她。”

“对不起什么呢？要不是齐藤先生一心向着你，你能破坏人家什么？何况他们是企业联姻，而不是互相喜欢。”

席舞不语，只是淡淡地微笑，左语恩的目光却被化妆台上的那只丝绒盒子给吸引住目光——

“那是什么？”

“你可以

当年，被席舞抛出窗外的那条玫瑰项链，原来是让齐藤英树给找回去了，此刻，它优雅地躺在黑丝绒的盒子里，闪耀着属于幸福的光芒。

“好漂亮的项链啊，是玫瑰呢，刻得好精致。”左语恩拿起项链细细瞧着。

“戴上吗？我帮你？”

“嗯，好。”席舞让左语恩替她戴上那条玫瑰项链，这项链是昨夜齐藤英树亲手交到她手上的，他什么也没说，就只是把它给了她。

齐藤英树当年没有骗她，这条玫瑰项链的确是他母亲送给他们兄弟俩未来媳妇的礼物，因为前阵子她在香子的脖子上也看见了长得一模一样的项链，她后来问了浅羽，浅羽这才跟她说，他们兄弟俩都有一条，只是上头刻的字不同。

她手上的这条，背后刻的是树，香子脖子上那条刻的是羽。

字很小很小，当年如果她再细心一点的话便会发现，虽然齐藤英树假装是浅羽来靠近她，但给她的项链却是属于他齐藤英树的，他把她当成他的未来媳妇，虽然她嫁的人是浅羽。

这种感觉，真的很奇妙，像是绕了大半个地球，这才发现她最爱的还是原来那个城市一样，有一股很淡很淡的惆怅，想着，如果一开始便知道这男人其实是对她用了真心，或许就不必浪费九年的时光，绕了这么长这么远的路。

但，这就是人生吧？

不经一事，不长一智。

很多事不亲自走上一遭，就不会懂得珍惜。

番外 诅咒

齐藤家的后院，永远是最宁静的角落，一个最适合谈话的地方。

巫师问那突然出现在婚礼上，对齐藤英树而言是惊喜也是意外，但对因为急着要上洗手间而不小心路过、眼尖看到巫师的席舞而言，却是个惊吓。

她没忘记齐藤英树之前对她所言，关于他要是没娶跟她同命格女子为妻，将活不过明年樱花盛开时的那句话。

如今齐藤英树娶了她，虽然她自始至终没有承认过她是舞冬末，可她的的确确是舞冬末本人，巫师却出现在婚礼上的原因是为何？是他算不出也认不出她是谁？

还是以为她是别人所以因担心而来？还是纯粹来给予祝福？

席舞是个急性子，学不来沉稳等待时机那一套，她速速找人将巫师请来后院，打算在婚礼还没正式开始前，搞清楚这件事。

席舞提着白纱曳地的裙摆单独而来，巫师问那见了她，打自眼底露出了笑意，是慈祥也是睿智的笑。

“好久不见了，夫人。”问那朝她福了福。

好久不见？席舞的眼神闪了闪。“我们以前见过吗？”

问那哈哈大笑。“夫人不是一眼就认出在下了，怎能说没见过？就算夫人容颜已改，可我们学巫的凭的是直觉与天赋，何况夫人善良热情的本性九年来从未曾变过，在下也是一眼便能认出夫人。”

这么玄？

席舞看着这位白发苍苍的老人，认输地朝他福了福。“好久不见了，问那师父，是小的我不知天高地厚，在关公面前耍大刀呢。”

问那又笑，朗朗笑声怕要传千里远去，看得出来心情极佳。

“敢问师父，您今日前来，莫非是以为英树未娶命格之女，将活不过明年樱花盛开时节之劫而来？”

嗄？巫师问那止住了笑，纳闷不已地看着她。“夫人这话是什么意思？我可从来没对大少爷说过这样的话啊。当年之咒已解，不会再行牵连，只是……当年我看出英树与夫人你之间的情缘甚深，错综复杂，算出若他到最后终是没法子得到你，他将注定一生孤寂，如此而已。”

竟是这样？

“师父，你没记错吧？”人老了，忘东忘西是很正常的。

“我脑子还没钝呢，夫人。”

席舞一呆一愣。“所以说……他说没娶跟我一样同命格的女人为妻将活不过明年春天，这句话根本是骗我的？”

问那闻言，倒是语重心长地说：“夫人，哀莫大于心死啊！若大少爷这辈子无法娶你为妻，跟你在一起，他的心就等于是死了，心都死了，人当然也就等于死了，不是吗？”

是啊，师父说的没错。

可，他终究还是骗了她啊！害她像个笨蛋似的，跑到蓝琳面前又跪又求的……

重点是，他究竟干么要这样骗她？

除非他早就知道她是舞冬末，知道她如果是舞冬末，听他这样说就一定会相信他，怕他会死，到最后一定就会心甘情愿乖乖嫁给他……

是这样吗？

所以，他才会把玫瑰项链拿给她，却一句话都不对她说？因为他知道她非常清楚那条项链的意义……

坏家伙！

九年前骗她的心！九年后骗她的人！

席舞咬牙。“师父……”

“嗯？”

席舞把裙摆提了起来。“我要逃婚。”

“什么？”问那大惊失色。千算万算，也没算到齐藤英树有此一劫啊？在政商名流齐聚一堂时被逃婚？被新娘子公然抛弃？“你真要这样玩吗，夫人？你确定你如果这么做，大少爷会再娶你一次？”

当然……

不确定！

席舞觉得很心虚，因为一点把握也没有，不过，要她这样乖乖嫁，她真的觉得自己太好骗也太好欺负了。

“说到底，夫人不是也骗了少爷吗？”问那突然来上一句。

当真是，一语惊醒梦中人啊。

她明明是舞冬末却打死不认，基本上也是一种欺骗……

“少爷成就夫人想重生的心，就算知道夫人真实身分也未曾点破，就是希望你可以幸福，不是吗？”

席舞看着巫师，巫师笑咪咪地望着她。“这喜酒我早就想喝啦，难得下山次，你别让我空手而回啊，夫人。”

她睨着巫师，内心依然纠结。

“不然我再提出一个你今日非嫁不可的理由？”

“你说。”

“他是你未来儿子的父亲，这已经是不能更改的事实。”

不能更改的事实？

席舞瞪大了眼，伸手抚上平坦的小肚子。“你是说……”

“恭喜夫人，今儿是双喜临门啊。”

番外 婚礼

齐藤大宅，现场乐队奏起了结婚进行曲，满天花瓣飞舞，小小的男女花童走在新娘子后头一直撒花，可爱模样几乎吸引住全场的目光。

“小花，我们的爸爸妈妈终于结婚了。”小男童边撒着花边对身旁的小女娃笑咪咪说道。

和小男童几乎长得一模一样的小女娃呵呵两声，笑得十分清脆可人。“对啊，终于，结婚照里有我们两个喔，叔叔说其他人的爸爸妈妈结婚时，结婚照里面是看不到他们的小孩的，只有我们不一样。”

Even if Xi Wu didn't immediately realize Zuo Yuen's thoughts about Hei Shao at first, when she later sent her the wedding invitation and Zuo Yuen saw that the groom's name was not Hei Shao, she was so excited that she cried. Only then did she realize that she had almost snatched away the man Zuo Yuen liked and ruined his happiness.

"If I hadn't left you behind that day, could you have married Mr. Saito today? I'm afraid you and I are going to attend the wedding of Mr. Saito and Miss Lan, right?" Zuo Yuen didn't show any weakness and replied."Speaking of which, I saw that Miss Lan also came to the wedding. Speaking of which, she is also generous. Miss Qianjin has a temper, but she is not very annoying."

"Yeah." Xi Wu nodded."I'm sorry for her."

"What are you sorry for? If Mr. Saito hadn't been devoted to you, what could you have done to destroy this family? Besides, they are a business marriage, not mutual liking."

Xi Wu said nothing, just smiled faintly, but Zuo Yuen's eyes were attracted by the velvet box on the dressing table——

"What's that?"

"You can

The rose necklace that was thrown out of the window by Xi Wu turned out to be retrieved by Hideki Saito. At this moment, it was lying elegantly in the black velvet box, shining with the light of happiness.

"What a beautiful necklace. It's a rose. It's so delicately carved."Zuo Yuen picked up the necklace and looked at it carefully.

"Put it on?Can I help you?"

"Well, okay."Xi Wu asked Zuo Yuen to put on the rose necklace for her. This necklace was handed to her by Saito Hideki personally last night. He didn't say anything, he just gave it to her.

Saito Hideki didn't lie to her back then. This rose necklace was indeed a gift from his mother to the two brothers' future wives, because she saw an identical necklace on Xiangzi's neck a while ago. She later asked Asayu, and Asayu told her that both brothers had one, but the words engraved on it were different.

The one on her hand is engraved with trees on the back, and the one on Xiangzi's neck is engraved with feathers.

The words were very small. If she had been more careful back then, she would have discovered that although Hideki Saito pretended to be Asaha to get close to her, the necklace given to her belonged to Hideki Saito. He regarded her as his future wife, even though the person she married was Asaha.

This feeling was truly amazing, as if she had traveled half way around the world, only to realize that the city she loved the most was still the same. There was a very faint melancholy, thinking that if she had known from the beginning that this man was actually sincere to her, maybe she wouldn't have had to waste nine years and take such a long detour.

But, this is life, right?

If you don't experience anything, you won't gain a piece of wisdom.

If you don't experience many things in person, you won't know how to cherish them.

Extra Curse

Saito's backyard is always the quietest corner, the most suitable place for conversation.

The sudden appearance of the wizard at the wedding was a surprise and surprise for Hideki Saito, but for Xi Wu, who accidentally passed by because he was in a hurry to go to the bathroom and saw the wizard with sharp eyes, it was a shock.

She has not forgotten what Saito Hideki said to her before, about what he said if he did not marry a woman with the same fate as her, he would not survive when the cherry blossoms bloom next year.

Now Saito Hideki has married her. Although she has never admitted that she is Wu Fuyusue, she is indeed Wu Fufusue herself. Why did the wizard appear at the wedding?Was it because he couldn't figure out or recognize who she was?

Or do you think she is someone else and come here out of worry?Or is it purely to give blessings?

Xi Wu was impatient and could not learn to wait for the opportunity calmly. She quickly found someone to invite the wizard to the backyard, intending to find out the matter before the wedding officially started.

Xi Wu came alone with a white gauze skirt that trailed to the floor. When the wizard saw her, he smiled from his eyes, a kind and wise smile.

"Long time no see, ma'am."Ask her if she was blessed.

Long time no see?Xi Wu's eyes flashed."Have we met before?"

Ask that and laugh."Madam, if you don't recognize me at a glance, how can you say you haven't seen him before?Even though Madam's appearance has changed, we learn witchcraft based on intuition and talent. Moreover, Madam's kind and enthusiastic nature has never changed in the past nine years, and I can recognize Madam at a glance."

So mysterious?

Xi Wu looked at the gray-haired old man and gave him a blessing in surrender."It's been a long time since I saw you. I asked the master. I was young and didn't know the heights of the world, but I was showing off with a big sword in front of Guan Gong."

He asked and laughed again. His laughter was so loud that it would spread thousands of miles away. It was obvious that he was in a very good mood.

"I dare to ask Master, did you come here today because you thought that Hideki would not survive the cherry blossom season next year if he did not marry the daughter of his destiny?"

Huh?The wizard stopped laughing and looked at her in confusion."What do you mean, madam?I have never said such words to the eldest young master.The curse from back then has been lifted and will no longer be implicated, but... back then I saw that the relationship between Hideki and your wife was deep and complicated, and I calculated that if he couldn't get you in the end, he would be doomed to be lonely all his life, that's all."

Is that so?

"Master, did you remember correctly?"It's normal for people to forget things when they get old.

"I'm not dull yet, ma'am."

Xi Wu was stunned for a while."So...he said that if he didn't marry a woman with the same destiny as me, he would not survive next spring. Is this a lie to me?"

When I asked Na, who heard the words, he said with great sincerity: "Madam, there is nothing more grieving than the death of your heart!If the eldest young master cannot marry you and be with you in this life, his heart will be as good as dead. If his heart is dead, then of course he will be as good as dead, right?"

Yes, Master is right.

But, he still lied to her after all!It made her act like an idiot, kneeling and begging in front of Lan Lin...

The point is, why on earth did he lie to her like this?

Unless he already knew that she was Wu Dongmo, and knew that if she were Wu Dongmo, she would definitely believe him when he said this, fearing that he would die, and in the end she would be willing to marry him obediently...

Is that so?

That's why he gave her the rose necklace but didn't say a word to her?Because he knew that she knew the meaning of that necklace very well...

Bad guy!

He lied to her heart nine years ago!The person who lied to her after nine years!

Xi Wu gritted his teeth."Master..."

"Huh?"

Xi Wu lifted up the hem of her skirt."I want to run away from marriage."

"What?" asked Na Na, who was shocked. After all calculations, Hideki Saito never imagined that he would be in this kind of calamity? Was he run away from his marriage when political and business celebrities gathered together? Was he openly abandoned by the bride? "Do you really want to play like this, madam?Are you sure that if you do this, the eldest young master will marry you again?"

Of course...

Not sure!

Xi Wu felt guilty because she had no confidence at all. However, if she was asked to marry like this, she really felt that she was too easy to deceive and too easy to bully.

"After all, didn't the madam also lie to the young master?"The question came up suddenly.

Seriously, one word can wake up the dreamer.

She was clearly Wu Dongmo but refused to acknowledge it. Basically, it was a kind of deception...

"Young Master fulfilled Madam's desire to be reborn. Even if he knew Madam's true identity, he never revealed it. He just wanted you to be happy, didn't he?"

Xi Wu looked at the wizard, who looked at her with a smile."I've been wanting to drink this wedding wine for a long time. It's a rare trip down the mountain, so don't let me come back empty-handed, madam."

She stared at the wizard, still confused.

"How about I come up with another reason why you have to get married today?"

"you say."

“He is the father of your future son, this is a fact that cannot be changed."

A fact that cannot be changed?

Xi Wu's eyes widened and she stretched out her hand to touch her flat belly."You mean..."

“Congratulations, madam, it’s a double happiness today."

extra wedding

At the Saito mansion, the live band played the wedding march, and flower petals were flying all over the sky. The little male and female flower girls walked behind the bride and kept scattering flowers. Their cute appearance attracted almost everyone's attention.

"Xiaohua, our parents are finally married."The little boy spread the flowers and said with a smile to the little girl beside him.

The little girl, who looked almost exactly like the little boy, chuckled twice and smiled very crisply and pleasantly."Yes, finally, there are two of us in the wedding photos. My uncle said that when other people's parents get married, their children cannot be seen in the wedding photos. Only we are different."
